description: This source file defines the 'PreSharedKeyDeviceIdentity' class, which implements device credential handling for pre-shared key authentication in an IoT context. It includes methods for creating identities from strings, comparing instances, and retrieving identity attributes.

classes.name: PreSharedKeyDeviceIdentity
classes.description: Represents a device identity based on a pre-shared key for authentication, supporting multi-tenant parsing and identity management.

methods.name: PreSharedKeyDeviceIdentity
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tenant ID and authentication ID, calculating the hash code.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from an identity string, optionally parsing tenant information with a separator.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the identity that the device wants to authenticate as.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID the device claims to belong to.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the object based on tenant and auth ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on tenant ID and auth ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the credentials type identifier for pre-shared key credentials.
